# BILL OF MATERIALS - SIH26113 Maternity Assist Belt

**75 line items, 150 placements.** Board: 100 x 70 mm, 4-layer FR-4 1.6 mm, 1 oz copper.

Supplier part numbers are deliberately absent: they were not verified in this environment, and a fabricated SKU is worse than no SKU. Manufacturer part numbers below were taken from the datasheet ordering guides cited in COMPONENT_VERIFICATION.md.

Blank MPN = a generic passive or connector where any part meeting the value and package is acceptable, or a part still to be selected (see REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION.md).

`BOM.csv` carries three further columns - **Supplier**, **Supplier PN** and **Lifecycle** - deliberately left empty. Distributor stock and lifecycle status could not be checked from the environment these files were produced in, and an invented SKU or an unverified "Active" is worse than a blank field. Fill them in from your own distributor.

## Assembly note

Three parts cannot be soldered with an iron: the AD8232 (0.5 mm-pitch QFN with a 2.5 mm exposed pad), the LSM6DSOX (0.5 mm LGA) and the TMP117 (0.65 mm WSON with a thermal pad). They need a stencil and a hotplate/reflow oven, or hot air with paste. Everything else on the board is 0805, SOT-23, SOIC/SOP-1.27 or through-hole, all of which are comfortable by hand.

## Parts NOT on this board

| Function | Why it is off-board |
|---|---|
| MAX17048 fuel gauge | Its data sheet could not be retrieved in this environment, so its land pattern could not be verified. Provided as header `J4` for an off-the-shelf breakout, plus an always-available resistor-divider battery measurement on `IO9`. See REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION.md. |
| Li-Po protection (DW01A + FS8205A) | A **protected** cell/pack is required at `J1` instead. Bare protection ICs were not added because their pinouts could not be verified from primary documentation, and guessing on a battery-protection circuit is not acceptable. |
| microSD socket | Implemented as a 6-way header (`J18`) for a standard SPI breakout module, matching the architecture diagram's 'module headers' approach and avoiding an unverified socket land pattern. |
| Load cell, FSRs, stretch sensor, piezo film, motor, buzzer, electrodes | Off-board transducers on flying leads. |
